patches.header:
Title: MoE cache modes, fewer experts per token, adaptive draft, head subset
Add-on: MoE expert cache modes for models whose experts live in host memory, an adaptive speculative draft length, and a GPU subset of the output head for draft steps.
  --moe-cache-cpu-miss (+ --moe-cache-promote-after/-max/-gain, --moe-cache-decay, --moe-cache-cpu-miss-max-tokens)
  --moe-cache-stats-file, --moe-cache-prewarm, --moe-cache-route-bias/-route-top/-route-scale, --moe-cache-foresight, --moe-cache-tail-skip(-rank, -auto-off)
  --moe-cache-evict-window, --moe-cache-pcie-share/-pcie-max/-pcie-auto(-window), --moe-cache-async-upload, --moe-cache-upload-batch, --moe-cache-swap-every/-swap-max
  --moe-cache-prefill-share, --moe-cache-prefill-max-tokens, --moe-cache-staging-slots (CPU share of prompt batches)
  --spec-draft-adaptive (+ -min-gain, -ema, -probe)
  --spec-draft-head-subset N: the MTP draft steps read the output head once per drafted token; with the head in host memory that is the biggest cost of a
  draft step. This keeps the first N rows and the last 1024 rows of the head in device memory for the draft. The target still verifies with the full head.
All off by default; stock behaviour is unchanged without the flags.
Requires: 0002-ggml-skip-negative-expert-ids-and-cpu-split-overlap.patch
